tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards; also the ground of inner tiles in dark mode.

tokens.name: bg-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar and other app-chrome rails. One step away from bg so the content area reads as the main surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, inputs, popovers. The main reading surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows and tiles nested inside a card.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and selected-row fill on surface; active nav item in dark mode.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, input borders, dividers between regions.

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside tables and lists; chart gridlines.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Chart baselines, keyboard-shortcut chips, emphasised separators.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on bg, surface and bg-sidebar in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, descriptions, column headers, breadcrumbs. Passes 4.5:1 on bg, surface and bg-sidebar.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Sidebar section labels and counts on bg-sidebar. Small text only; never on surface-hover.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: The brand accent. Primary button fill, links, active-nav marker, focus ring. At most one primary action per view.

tokens.name: copper-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of copper fills and links.

tokens.name: on-copper
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a copper fill. Never use ink on copper.

tokens.name: copper-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for a selected item or an info callout using copper.

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: The second brand hue (the patina). Logo bars, second chart series, secondary highlights. Not a status colour.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First data series (usually messages in). Lighter than copper in light mode because it is a line, not text.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second data series (usually messages out).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series, comparisons and previous-period overlays.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy state: status dots, sparklines, positive deltas, the Live indicator.

tokens.name: ok-text
tokens.usage: Text on ok-soft (the Healthy badge).

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Healthy badge.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning state: lag rising, under min ISR soon. Dots, sparklines, delta text.

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: Text on warn-soft (the Warn badge).

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Warn badge.

tokens.name: crit
tokens.usage: Critical state: Stalled, Stopped, offline partitions, broker down, destructive actions.

tokens.name: crit-text
tokens.usage: Text on crit-soft (the Stalled and Stopped badges, alert counts).

tokens.name: crit-soft
tokens.usage: Background of critical badges and the alert-count chip.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline with a 2px offset on every interactive element.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen, top of the content area.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Partition 7 has committed the same offset for 6 minutes.
styles.usage: Default UI text: tables, lists, descriptions.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Alert titles, active nav item, emphasised cells.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary lines, deltas, helper text, badges.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Sidebar section labels, in capitals, ink-subtle.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: KPI values. Tabular figures so live numbers don't jitter.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Topic names, group ids, offsets, lag numbers, keys, cluster names.

styles.name: data-small
styles.usage: Counts in nav, shortcut chips, axis labels, time-range buttons.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside small chips; gap between swatch tiles.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label; badge horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between items in a list; nav item horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections when 16px feels tight.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Content area padding; top bar horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large separation, empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, count chips, shortcut chips, swatches.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, nav items, cluster switcher.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and pills only.

shadow.note: Copper Oxide uses borders, not shadows. The one shadow is for things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, command palette, toasts. Never on cards.

size.note: Fixed dimensions of the app shell and controls.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense controls inside table rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input and segmented-control height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions on touch layouts; the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar with breadcrumb, search, time range and Live indicator.

reduced.note: Under [data-motion=reduced] or prefers-reduced-motion: movement off; fades max 120ms; no pulses, flows or shimmer.
